name: Boooks Master Scan System
description: Full hierarchical structure for scanning, labeling, and analyzing books in physical and digital formats.

phases.name: Outer Shell
phases.description: All external parts of the book before it opens.

children.name: Dust Jacket
children.description: Removable paper jacket around hardcovers; may include flaps.

children.name: Front
children.description: Front cover of the dust jacket

children.name: Spine
children.description: Spine section of the dust jacket

children.name: Back
children.description: Back cover of the dust jacket

children.name: Front Flap
children.description: Inner folded flap, often with summary or reviews

children.name: Back Flap
children.description: Inner folded flap, often with author bio or publisher info

children.name: Inner Surface
children.description: The inside of the dust jacket (if scanned flat)

children.name: Book Cover
children.description: Main outer layer (hardcover or softcover). May include built-in French flaps.

children.name: Front Cover
children.description: Visible when book is closed, usually with title & art

children.name: Spine
children.description: Vertical edge with title and publisher logo

children.name: Back Cover
children.description: Contains summary, barcode, or blurbs

children.name: Front Flap (French)
children.description: Folded-in extension on front cover

children.name: Back Flap (French)
children.description: Folded-in extension on back cover

children.name: Inside Cover Surface
children.description: Inside part of the front/back cover board

children.name: Barcode / ISBN Zone
children.description: Barcode, ISBN, or price tag usually located on back cover or jacket.

children.name: Page Edges
children.description: Sides of the closed book (top, side, bottom) — may contain color, pattern, or gilding.

children.name: Dimensions
children.description: Measurements: height, width, and spine thickness. Supports custom calibration paths.

children.name: Weight
children.description: Book weight in grams, if measured or scanned via scale module.

phases.name: Inner Content
phases.description: Scanned content inside the book, from endpapers to last page.

children.name: Front Endpaper
children.description: Decorative or blank page glued to the cover

children.name: Front Flyleaf
children.description: Blank page before the title page

children.name: Title Page
children.description: Shows title, author, and publisher

children.name: Copyright Page
children.description: Legal information and edition details

children.name: Main Content
children.description: Core body of the book

children.name: Chapters
children.description: Individual chapters, typically multiple scans

children.name: Language Detection
children.description: Auto-detect text language(s)

children.name: OCR Quality Check
children.description: Evaluate text extraction accuracy

children.name: Physical Condition
children.description: Detect tears, folds, or dirt

children.name: Re-scan / Stitching Pass
children.description: Enhance scan resolution or correct warps

children.name: Page Orientation
children.description: Detect and correct rotation/skew

children.name: Scan Integrity Hash
children.description: Verify file consistency (for blockchain)

children.name: Text Embedding
children.description: Generate vector representations for search

children.name: Semantic Chapter Segmentation
children.description: AI-based split by meaning rather than page breaks

children.name: Metadata Blockchain Sync
children.description: Commit scan hashes to blockchain
